sources.title: Gemma 4 Abliteration - GitHub
sources.snippet: Dense models (E2B, E4B, 31B): Norm-preserving biprojected abliteration. Per-layer refusal directions are computed from 800 harmful/harmless prompt residuals, orthogonalized against harmless means, and projected out of o_proj + mlp.down_proj weights while preserving row norms. Unified model (12B): Same dense biprojection on the text decoder. gemma-4-12B-it is the encoder-free Gemma4Unified arch ...
